hint.import: import cannot be used. Only built-in functions are available.
hint.from: import cannot be used. Only built-in functions are available.
hint.while: while is not supported. Loops can only run with for over a list or range.
hint.lambda: lambda is not supported. Define functions with def at the top level.
hint.try: try/except is not supported. Raise errors with fail(code, message).
hint.raise: raise is not supported. Raise errors with fail(code, message).
hint.global: global is not supported. Functions can only use their arguments and constants.
hint.assert: assert is not supported. Check with if and fail(code, message).
hint.print: print is not supported. Scripts have no input or output.
hint.is: is is not supported. Compare values with == and !=.

syntax.tabIndent: Tab characters cannot be used for indentation. Use 4 spaces.
syntax.indentUnit: Indentation must be a multiple of 4 spaces. (currently {{spaces}})
syntax.singleQuote: Single-quoted strings are not supported. Use double quotes (").
syntax.indentTooDeep: Indentation cannot be more than one level (4 spaces) deeper at a time.
syntax.brace: Braces are not supported. There are no dictionaries or sets.
syntax.semicolon: Only one statement per line. Do not join statements with ;.
syntax.lineContinuation: Line continuation (\) is not supported. You can break lines inside parentheses.
syntax.float: Floating-point numbers are not supported. Only integers can be used.
syntax.invalidNumber: Invalid number '{{p0}}'. (use the 0x prefix for hex, 0b for binary)
syntax.reservedName: Names starting with '__' cannot be used. ('{{word}}')
syntax.badUnicodeEscape: \u must be followed by 4 hex digits.
syntax.fstringBrace: Unpaired '}'. Write a brace character as '}}'.
syntax.fstringField: An f-string expression cannot contain quotes, '{' or '\' and must be closed with '}'. Put strings in a variable first.
syntax.fstringEmpty: An empty field {} is not allowed. Write it as {expression}.
syntax.fstringSpec: A format spec must be closed with '}' and cannot contain quotes, '{' or '\'.
syntax.hexInvalidChar: h"..." can only contain hex digits (0-9, a-f) and spaces. The character '{{c}}' is not allowed.{{hint}}
syntax.hexOddDigits: The number of hex digits must be even. (currently {{length}}) The last digit has no pair.
syntax.binInvalidChar: b"..." is a binary literal and can only contain 0, 1 and spaces. The character '{{c}}' is not allowed. This is not a Python bytes literal: use h"87 23" for hex and s"abc" for text.
syntax.binBitCount: The number of bits must be a multiple of 8. (currently {{length}} bits) The last byte starting here does not have 8 bits.
syntax.literalPrefixSpace: The prefix {{text}} and the opening quote must be written together. ({{text}}"...")
syntax.attribute: Attribute access (.) and method calls are not supported. Use a built-in function instead. (e.g. len(x), to_hex(b))
syntax.noPowerOperator: There is no '{{text}}' operator. Use pow(base, exp, mod) for exponentiation.
syntax.noDivOperator: There is no '{{text}}' operator. Use '//' for integer division.
syntax.blockNextLine: Write a block on the following lines, indented by 4 spaces.
syntax.defTopLevelOnly: Functions can only be defined at the top level.
syntax.annotationNeedsValue: A declaration with a type annotation needs an initial value (= value).
syntax.unpackRhs: The right side of an unpacking assignment must be a function call or a tuple.
syntax.exprStatementCallIndex: An expression statement can only be a function call. To change a value, assign it as x[i] = value.
syntax.exprStatementCall: An expression statement can only be a function call.
syntax.paramNeedsType: Parameter '{{text}}' needs a type annotation ({{text}}: int, etc.).
syntax.paramDefault: Parameter default values are not supported.
syntax.unknownType: Unknown type '{{text}}'. (int, bool, bytes, string, list[...])
syntax.chainedComparison: Chained comparisons (a < b < c) are not supported. Split them like (a < b) and (b < c).
syntax.callByNameOnly: Functions can only be called by name.
syntax.positionalAfterKeyword: A positional argument cannot follow a keyword argument.
syntax.tupleContext: A tuple can only be used in a return statement or on the right side of an unpacking assignment.
syntax.comprehension: Comprehensions are not supported. Use a for loop and += [value] on the list.
syntax.literalMixedKind: Literals of different kinds ({{first}}"..." and {{second}}"...") cannot be joined. To join them, use the same kind or connect them with +.
syntax.literalConcatOutsideParen: Literals can only be joined inside parentheses. Wrap them in parentheses or connect them with +.
syntax.sourceTooLarge: The script source is too large. ({{size}} bytes, limit {{MAX_SOURCE}} bytes)

token.name: a name
token.type: a type (int, bool, bytes, string, list[...])

port.reservedPrefix: An id starting with '__' cannot be used.
port.reservedWord: A reserved word cannot be used as an id.
port.builtinName: The id conflicts with a built-in function name.
port.invalidType: The type '{{dataType}}' cannot be used. (only bytes, int, bool and string)

output.unassigned: The output variable '{{id}}' is not assigned on every execution path. It must be assigned by the end of the script.

check.emptyListToVar: An empty list [] cannot be assigned to a {{ann}} variable.
check.annotationMismatch: The type annotation is {{ann}} but the value is {{ty}}.
check.loopOnly: {{kw}} can only be used inside a for loop.
check.nameIsBuiltin: '{{name}}' is a built-in function name and cannot be used.
check.nameIsFunction: '{{name}}' is a function name and cannot be used as a variable.
check.nameIsConst: '{{name}}' is a constant name and cannot be redefined.
check.constTopLevel: The constant '{{name}}' can only be defined at the top level.
check.constSingleAssign: The constant '{{name}}' can only be defined with a single assignment.
check.constInit: The initial value of the constant '{{name}}' can only be made from literals, other constants and built-in function calls.
check.inputReadOnly: The input port variable '{{name}}' is read-only and cannot be reassigned.
check.outputTypeMismatch: The type of the output variable '{{name}}' is {{type}}, the same as the output port, but a {{ty}} value was assigned.
check.varTypeFixed: The variable '{{name}}' has type {{type}}, but a {{ty}} value was assigned. A variable's type does not change.
check.maybeUnassigned: The variable '{{name}}' may not be assigned. Assign it on every execution path before reading it. (An assignment inside a for loop is not treated as assigned after the loop.)
check.fnOuterName: Inside a function, input port variables, output variables and the top-level variable '{{name}}' cannot be used. Pass it as an argument.
check.nameIsFunctionValue: '{{name}}' is a function and cannot be used as a value. Call it: {{name}}(...)
check.augTypeMismatch: The result of '{{op}}=' is {{res}}, so it cannot be assigned to the {{lt}} variable '{{name}}'.
check.subscriptAssignType: Subscript assignment cannot be used on a {{t}} value.
check.elementAssignMismatch: Elements of {{t}} must be assigned a {{want}} value, but it is {{vt}}.
check.sliceAssignType: Slice assignment can only be used on bytes. ('{{name}}' is {{t}})
check.sliceAssignValue: A bytes value must be assigned to a slice, but it is {{vt}}.
check.unpackRhsTuple: The right side of an unpacking assignment must be a function call that returns a tuple, or a tuple.
check.unpackArity: The left side of the unpacking assignment has {{length}} targets, but the right side has {{length2}}.
check.unpackDuplicate: The same name '{{name}}' appears twice in the unpacking assignment.
check.forIterable: The for loop target must be list, bytes or range, but it is {{t}}.
check.loopVarDefined: The loop variable '{{name}}' is already defined. Use a different name.
check.returnOutsideFn: return can only be used inside a function.
check.returnWithoutType: A function without a return type cannot return a value. Declare a -> type on the function.
check.returnValueRequired: This function must return a {{type}} value.
check.returnTypeMismatch: The return type is {{ret}}, but a {{t}} value was returned.
check.returnTupleRequired: This function must return {{type}}. Write it like return (a, b).
check.returnTupleArity: The returned tuple must have {{length}} items, but it has {{length2}}.
check.returnTupleItem: Item {{index}} of the returned tuple must be {{want}}, but it is {{t}}.
check.fnNameBuiltin: '{{name}}' is a built-in function name and cannot be used as a function name.
check.fnNamePort: The function name '{{name}}' conflicts with a port name.
check.fnNameVar: The function name '{{name}}' conflicts with a variable or constant name.
check.fnMissingReturn: The function '{{name}}' must return {{type}}, but some execution paths do not end with return.
check.voidAsValue: A call to a function that returns no value cannot be used as a value.
check.rangeContext: range can only be used as the target of a for loop.
check.mustBeBool: {{what}} must be bool, but it is {{t}}. There is no truthiness; use a comparison. (e.g. x != 0)
check.mustBeInt: {{what}} must be int, but it is {{t}}.
check.intLiteralTooLarge: The int literal is too large. ({{bits}} bits, limit {{MAX_INT_BITS}} bits)
check.notOperand: The operand of not must be bool, but it is {{t}}.
check.unaryOperand: The unary '{{op}}' cannot be used on {{t}}.
check.conditionalTypes: The two values of a conditional expression must have the same type, but they are {{a}} and {{b}}.
check.emptyListAnnotation: An empty list [] can only be used with a type annotation. e.g. xs: list[bytes] = []
check.listElementTypes: All list elements must have the same type, but {{type0}} and {{t}} are mixed.
check.subscriptType: A subscript cannot be used on a {{t}} value. (only bytes and lists)
check.binaryOperand: The operator '{{op}}' cannot be used on {{l}} and {{r}}.{{hint}}
check.rangeNotValue: range can only be used as the target of a for loop. It cannot be stored or passed.
check.fnDefinedBeforeCall: The function '{{name}}' must be defined above where it is called. Recursion and mutual recursion are not allowed.
check.argType: The argument '{{name2}}' of {{name}} must be {{want}}, but it is {{t}}.
check.noKeywordArgs: User functions have no keyword arguments.
check.argCount: The function '{{name}}' needs {{length}} arguments but {{length2}} were passed.
check.userArgType: The argument '{{param}}' of the function '{{name}}' must be {{want}}, but it is {{t}}.
check.rangeArgs: range takes 1 to 3 positional arguments (int): range(n), range(start, stop), range(start, stop, step)

hint.noImplicitCast: There is no implicit type conversion.
hint.useConversion: Convert explicitly with to_int or to_bytes.
hint.andOrBool: The operands of and/or must be bool.

format.unparsable: Cannot parse the format spec '{{raw}}'. Format: [[fill]align][sign][#][0][width][type]
format.widthTooLarge: The width {{width}} of the format spec exceeds the limit {{MAX_FORMAT_WIDTH}}.
format.zeroWithAlign: The '0' flag cannot be used together with fill or alignment.
format.typeNotFormattable: A {{ty}} value cannot be inserted into a string. (only int, string, bytes and bool)
format.typeNotAllowed: The format '{{type}}' cannot be used on a {{ty}} value. (allowed: {{allowed}})
format.intOnlyFlags: The sign, '#' and '0' flags can only be used on int values. ({{ty}} value)
format.altForm: '#' can only be used with the formats x, X, b and o.

limit.intTooLarge: The int is too large. ({{bits}} bits, limit {{maxIntBits}} bits)
limit.bytesTooLong: The bytes value is too long. ({{length}} bytes, limit {{maxBytes}} bytes)
limit.listTooLong: The list is too long. ({{n}} items, limit {{maxListLen}} items)

eval.powExponent: The exponent of pow must be 0 or greater.
eval.powModulus: The mod of pow must be 1 or greater.
eval.failReservedCode: The code of fail cannot start with 'SCRIPT_' or 'BYTES_'. ('{{code}}')
eval.stepLimit: The execution step limit ({{maxSteps}}) was exceeded.
eval.timeout: The execution time limit was exceeded.
eval.inputType: The value of the input port '{{id}}' is not of type {{t}}.
eval.outputUnassigned: The output variable '{{id}}' was not assigned.
eval.rangeStepZero: The step of range cannot be 0.
eval.loopLimit: The number of iterations exceeds the limit ({{maxListLen}}).
eval.sliceLengthMismatch: The slice length {{sliceLength}} differs from the length {{length}} of the assigned value.
eval.noValue: There is no value for the name '{{name}}'.
eval.bytesOperator: The operator {{op}} is not defined for bytes.
eval.shiftNegative: The shift amount must be 0 or greater.
eval.shiftTooLarge: The shift result exceeds the int limit ({{maxIntBits}} bits).
eval.intOperator: The operator {{op}} is not defined for int.
eval.listIndex: List index {{i}} is out of range. (length {{len}})

builtin.len: Length of bytes or a list
builtin.zeros: A bytes value of n 0x00 bytes
builtin.fill: A bytes value of the byte value (0 to 255) repeated n times
builtin.concat: Joins a list of bytes values
builtin.blocks: A list split into pieces of size bytes
builtin.to_ints: Each byte as a list of integers 0 to 255
builtin.from_ints: A list of integers 0 to 255 as a bytes value
builtin.rol: Rotates left, treating the whole value as one bit string
builtin.ror: Rotates right, treating the whole value as one bit string
builtin.ct_equals: Equality comparison whose time does not depend on the mismatch position
builtin.to_int: A bytes value as an integer
builtin.to_bytes: An integer as exactly length bytes
builtin.from_hex: A hex string as a bytes value
builtin.to_hex: A bytes value as a hex string
builtin.str: An integer as a decimal string
builtin.bit_length: The minimum number of bits needed to represent abs(n)
builtin.range: Iteration range for for only: range(n), range(start, stop), range(start, stop, step)
builtin.fail: Stops execution and makes the node ERROR
